description: This file defines a UI fragment for browsing videos in an Android TV app using Leanback library. It displays a list of videos and handles user clicks to start a video player activity.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment extending BrowseSupportFragment that displays a list of videos in a single row and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the UI components, and registers click listeners.

methods.name: setupRows
methods.description: Creates and populates the row of video items to be displayed.

methods.name: setupClickListeners
methods.description: Registers a click listener to handle user taps on video items, launching the PlayerActivity.
